_comment: What scripts/sync-youtube.mjs reads from YouTube. A source with `uploads: true` takes the channel's uploads and files them by title (scripts/catalog-rules.mjs): 'EP.05 | Name' and 'Hook | Name 3화' are episodes of Name, anything else is a single work. `skip.titles` keeps videos whose title carries one of the words off the site; `skip.clips` leaves out Shorts that have no episode number (clips cut from an episode). `exclude` hides a video or playlist by id. A source can also list `videos: [ids]` to show them whatever the rules say, or take `playlists: true` (needs YOUTUBE_API_KEY) to make every public playlist a series in its own order. `overrides`, keyed by series id ('series:Name', a video id or a playlist id), can set `title`, `description`, `slug`, `cover`/`coverWidth` (a file under public/) and `featured: true`. Channels under `channels` are named by their YouTube id (UC…, which survives a renamed handle).
